result.evidence_quote: We evaluated the association between adding RFH to first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) plus chemotherapy and outcomes in patients with HER2-negative advanced gastric/gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma.
result.rationale: The study evaluates cancer treatment and survival in advanced gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma. It does not address cardiovascular conditions, cardiovascular risk prediction or prevention, or therapies for cardiovascular outcomes.
